raw_brief: Build a landing page for Cadence, a developer tool. Dark.

surface.scope: single standalone page, offline-renderable from file://

product.name: Cadence
product.category: developer tool — pipeline health / delivery rhythm monitor
product.working_definition: Cadence watches a team's build-test-deploy pipeline as one continuous signal instead of a wall of dashboards: every commit produces a pulse, and a broken or slowing pulse is the alert — not a form you fill in after an incident.
product.rationale: The brief names only 'a developer tool' with no further spec. The director fixed one concrete, plausible identity that the name itself suggests — 'Cadence' as rhythm/pulse of shipping, not a release-approval workflow — and held it fixed for every section, copy line, and the generated hero artwork. This is a creative decision, not a brief requirement, recorded here so it reads as intentional.

audience.primary: engineers and eng leads at small-to-mid teams who currently learn about a broken pipeline from a teammate, not from a system
audience.mindset_on_arrival: skeptical of another dashboard to check; wants to see the actual signal shape (a real trace, a real command) before believing a claim about visibility

outcome.primary_action: start watching a pipeline (primary CTA: install / get started)
outcome.secondary_action: see the live trace / read the docs (secondary CTA + concrete product specimen)
outcome.page_job: in one scroll, make the reader feel the idea of a 'pulse' (a continuous signal, not a dashboard), show how one commit becomes a pulse, prove the tool is real with an actual command's output, and state honestly what it plugs into

taste_profile.layout: high — asymmetric, editorial marquee hero; landing/marketing surface
taste_profile.typography: high — expressive 1.5 ratio scale, large display sizes, strong weight contrast
taste_profile.spacing: high — airy gallery-mode rhythm for marketing bands, deliberately dense inside the terminal specimen and integrations grid
taste_profile.motion: mid-high — orchestrated scroll entrance + hover feedback, restrained for a technical audience (no bounce, no gratuitous looping)
taste_profile.iconography: mid — one consistent hand-authored line-icon set, single weight
taste_profile.depth: mid — small named elevation ramp, hairline borders over heavy shadow, dark-mode tinted shadows
taste_profile.consistency: not scorable — first generation in an empty project workspace (spec 019 benchmark build), no established design system to inherit

mode.brand_accent: warm amber/gold pulse-line signal against a near-black ink background, with a muted teal harmonic as the only secondary accent — deliberately avoids the indigo/violet 'AI-glow' band per taste-rubric Axis 6 anti-pattern

constraints.offline: no CDN, no remote fonts, no remote images, no network requests at runtime — system font stack, inline SVG, one locally generated + compressed JPEG asset
constraints.effort: a complete, real landing page — genuine effort, not a stub
constraints.blinding: index.html and its assets must contain no comment, meta tag, footer credit, class name, or copy naming any model, vendor, tool, generator, 'DESIGN:OS', or 'AI'

out_of_scope: working backend, auth, or live install flow (CTAs are static anchors)
fabricated customer logos, testimonials, or metrics (per page-structures.md §3 honest copy)
